name: DependencyLookup
summary: Asks a registry for its collaborators, so that a test can substitute what the registry answers.

roles.name: DependencyLookup
roles.summary: The other answer: the participant fetches, and the test changes what it fetches. It keeps constructors simple and moves the substitution to a place no signature mentions — so a test that fails because somebody forgot to reset the registry fails a long way from the cause.
